about_the_game:
You are the supervillain this mall has been trying to stop.

Break through skylights, crash into storefronts, and rocket across a massive multi-level mega-mall using a thruster-powered exo suit.
Exo Mayhem is all about movement, destruction, and creating your own style of chaos as you unlock new upgrades and abilities.

This is not a story about saving the day.
This is a chance to enjoy being the problem.

Unleash Your Inner Villain

Hit glass walls at full speed.
Send security guards flying.
Blast crowds with shockwaves.
Smash into shops like they’re made of cardboard.

This isn’t a rescue mission. This is your playground, and chaos is the whole point.

Thruster-Powered Flight and Mobility

Your exo suit is built for fast, messy movement. You can boost, dash, hover, grapple-launch yourself forward, hit short bursts of speed, and steer in mid-air.
The movement feels good once everything clicks and you start chaining moves together during fights or escapes.

Movement options include:

  • boost thrusters

  • air dashes

  • hovering

  • grapple boosts

  • super-speed bursts

  • mid-air steering

A Biophilic Mega-Mall Built for Chaos

Explore a large vertical space with two main districts:

  • The Jungle District, filled with dense greenery, a huge waterfall, open stores, and wide paths that let you move and fight at full speed.

  • The Cave District, a darker biome with bioluminescent lighting, tight corners, and close-quarters layouts that force quick reactions and cleaner movement.

A central tunnel links the two areas, and each district reacts differently to the chaos you create. Moving between them keeps the game feeling fresh.

Over 40 Supervillain Powers to Unlock

Customize your exo suit with abilities like:

  • explosive punches

  • grenade launchers

  • Iron-Man style flight boosts

  • grapple movement

  • mobility upgrades

  • plasma blades

  • and plenty more to experiment with

Every upgrade adds a new way to cause trouble and tear through the mall.

Guns and Weapon Mods

Alongside your powers, you also have access to a small set of sci-fi firearms.
There are four weapons in total: a long-range rifle, a pump shotgun, a semi-auto shotgun, and a full-auto rifle.
Across all of them you can unlock 32 weapon upgrades, giving you plenty of ranged options if you want to mix guns into your villain loadout.

Play the Way You Want

Follow villain missions, fight mall security, destroy high-value targets, chase upgrades, or just free-roam and create chaos for as long as you feel like.
The game doesn’t force you into one style. Your powers and movement let you approach everything your own way.

Bonus Mode: Apocalypse Survival

There is also an optional survival mode inspired by COD Zombies. It takes place in a ruined version of the mall where endless waves of enemies keep getting tougher. You can upgrade your exo suit during the run and see how long you can stay alive.
This is separate from the main game and meant as extra replay content.

Become the villain. Break the mall. Enjoy the chaos.

content_descriptors.notes: When you kill a human enemy there is blood and gore.
